owner_observations: PSU002 is otherwise identical to PSU001.

visible_observations.observation: PSU002 inventory label on component side.
Connector board marked 105-330-2757-7; rail labels 5N, 12N, 12P, 5P and 0V.

limits: PSU002 is a separate specimen; owner comparison does not transfer PSU001 repair history or identify the installed museum supply.
V15 is identified by placement correlation; full pin-to-net continuity is not verified. The fitted BU126 differs from SU169 in the reference drawing.
Photographs support placement, markings and visible copper inspection; hidden connections and electrical condition are not established.

visible_observations.observation: Transistor marked BU126 and 04 87 on a vertical plate heatsink.
PSU001 inventory label and surrounding assembly visible.
BU126 heatsink position in PSU001 corresponds visually to the empty heatsink position in PSU002, using the adjacent magnetic component, capacitor group and resistor pair as landmarks.

limits: The populated and empty positions correlate with V15 in placement drawing 63-330-2760-4; no complete pin-to-net verification.
The fitted BU126 does not establish factory population, repair history or qualification as a replacement for the reference drawing transistor.

layout_correlation.reference_role: Primary switch for the Tr3 / 12PM flyback section
layout_correlation.basis: Vertical heatsink between R9/R10 and Tr3, next to the V11–V14 rectifier bank and C13–C15 group. The same landmarks locate the absent part in PSU002.
layout_correlation.remaining: No complete pin-to-net trace or continuity measurement; factory population and BU126 replacement qualification remain unknown.

connector_orientation.limit: Solder pad groups only; mating-face pin 1 is not established by these photographs.
